title: SentinelOne Arms Partners to Build and Scale AI Security Practices
summary: LevelBlue, GuidePoint Security, and World Wide Technology named launch partners as SentinelOne expands PartnerOne with new certifications, and Authorized…
body_markdown:
*LevelBlue, GuidePoint Security, and World Wide Technology named launch partners as SentinelOne expands PartnerOne with new certifications, and Authorized Deployment Partner Program, and early access to Singularity Agentic Detection and Response*


**MOUNTAIN VIEW, Calif. and LAS VEGAS, Nev. – October 21, 2026 –**[SentinelOne®](https://www.sentinelone.com/) (NYSE: S), the AI Security leader, today announced a major expansion of its PartnerOne program to help partners build and scale AI Security businesses, giving value-added resellers (VARs) and managed service providers, including MSSPs, MSPs, and MDR providers, a certified path to build AI Security and Autonomous SOC (ASOC) practices on SentinelOne’s Singularity™ Platform. Unveiled at SentinelOne's OneCon 2026 conference, the expansion of the program will feature LevelBlue, GuidePoint, and World Wide Technology (WWT) as premier launch partners, with a broader rollout to the company’s PartnerOne network in the coming months.


“AI Security represents the biggest cybersecurity opportunity for the channel in decades, and we view our VAR and managed service providers as the force multipliers for SentinelOne’s AI Security business,” said Barry Padgett, President and COO of SentinelOne. “We want our partners to own the service layer as a decisive advantage for us and our customers, alike. The introduction of our partner-led AI Security Services will give partners the skills, expertise and offerings needed to meet the rapidly growing customer demand today, and the foundation upon which to build high-growth, durable AI Security practices into their broader portfolio."


SentinelOne’s portfolio focuses on two critical and often related aspects of AI in cybersecurity: securing the new AI attack surface, and empowering and automating security operations with AI. SentinelOne’s partners are already the trusted providers of security software and services used by organizations across the globe today. From resellers to managed security services providers, this growing network has built up strong, high-growth runtime security practices to help customers defend endpoint, identity, and cloud workload attack surfaces. The introduction of SentinelOne’s partner-led AI Security Services gives these same partners the opportunity to directly lead their customers’ AI Security and ASOC programs, building new scalable businesses on the same foundation that they already trust today.


A new core component of SentinelOne’s PartnerOne program, the partner-led AI Security Services will give partners the opportunity to receive certifications on SentinelOne’s AI Security and Autonomous SOC portfolio for implementation, customization, administration, and ongoing professional and managed services. The program includes:


**AI Security:**


- **SentinelOne Prompt Security Implementation Engineer Certification** – SentinelOne Prompt Security gives organizations visibility and control over how AI is used across their business, protecting against prompt injection, sensitive data leakage, and unsanctioned AI use. Prompt Implementation Engineer Certification includes an online learning path providing partner-facing deployment guidance for Prompt for Employees and AI Code Assistants, and a certification exam to validate an engineer's ability to deliver. Available today.
- **Early Access to Singularity ADR** – Built on the Singularity Platform, the new Singularity Agentic Detection and Response (ADR) pairs agent visibility and governance with SentinelOne’s runtime behavioral prevention, detection and response to stop unintended and malicious AI agent activity at machine speed. Partners can join the Singularity ADR early access program starting today and build agent security services alongside their first customers.
- **Endpoint & Identity Implementation Engineer Certification –** Online learning path and certification covering implementation and administration of SentinelOne's Endpoint & Identity solutions, enabling delivery partners to help their customers realize value quickly.
- **AI Recon Assessment Service –** enables partners to engage prospects in meaningful conversations about AI security, using Prompt to put partners firmly in the lead in strengthening their prospects’ AI security posture.


**Autonomous SOC (ASOC):**


- **ASOC Data Strategy Assessment Service** – Gives partners a structured way to help customers decide what data to ingest, what to route to lower-cost storage, and what to query in place, so SOC data decisions are driven by detection and investigation needs instead of cost alone. Built on SentinelOne AI SIEM and AI Data Pipelines.
- **ASOC Implementation Certifications and Learning Paths –** Includes online learning paths and certification for **AI Data Pipelines Implementation** , covering onboarding, parsing and normalization, routing, and pipeline management of data in the SOC; **Purple AI and Hyperautomation Implementation,** covering AI-driven investigation and automated response workflows in the SOC, including Purple AI setup and administration, Hyperautomation workflow design, including how to scope and size consumption; as well as **AI SIEM Implementation,** designed to enable delivery partners to implement AI SIEM for their customers, combined with a certification exam to validate delivery competence.


Certified delivery partners receive access to product-specific Delivery Packages. These tools fast-track practice development including scoping and sizing guides, Statement of Work templates, deployment runbooks, structured project plans and best practices. Moreover, these same partners will be recognized publicly so customers can easily discern who is best suited to set them up for success.


“Customers are asking how to adopt AI without losing track of who and what can reach their data. Our work in AI governance and agentic AI security shows us exactly where that gap opens up. As a launch partner for SentinelOne’s AI Security Services, we can pair that advisory depth with certified expertise on the platform and take customers from assessment through implementation.”
– **Mark Thornberry, Chief Business Officer, GuidePoint.**


“Every enterprise is racing to put AI to work, and attackers are racing right alongside them. As a launch partner for SentinelOne’s AI Security Services, WWT is helping customers turn AI security from a growing concern into an operational capability, bringing together the expertise, technology, and services needed to innovate securely and at scale.”


– **Jill Cochrane, Vice President and General Manager of Global Security Consulting, WWT.**


“Customers adopting AI need more than a deployment plan; they need a partner to run security
operations alongside them every day. Building on our expanding partnership with SentinelOne,
LevelBlue brings the global scale as its MSSP launch partner for AI Security Services to take
customers from implementation to ongoing managed operations, helping them secure their use
of AI and build toward a managed Autonomous SOC.”


**– Sundhar Annamalai, LevelBlue Chief Strategy Officer**


**About SentinelOne**
SentinelOne (NYSE: S) is the leader in AI security, setting the standard for using AI and automation to give defenders a decisive operating advantage. Built for those who secure our world, its platform delivers unified coverage across endpoints, identity, cloud, and AI. Powered by Autonomous Security Intelligence, SentinelOne stops attacks at machine speed, reducing risk and delivering clarity and control to stay one step ahead. Headquartered in Mountain View, California, with teams worldwide, SentinelOne protects nearly one-fifth of the Fortune 500 and hundreds of Global 2000 enterprises. From Main Street to Wall Street, the world's most critical organizations trust SentinelOne with their security.
